cases.question: We switch to equipment with automated self-testing and self-diagnostics. Can we skip the monthly visual inspection too?
cases.label: correct
cases.reasoning: Correctly says automated self-testing does not eliminate monthly visual inspection, and identifies supervisory/trouble signals and other malfunction indicators. Annual testing remains a separate correctly stated obligation.

cases.answerText: **No.** If the equipment uses its automated self-testing and self-diagnostic feature instead of monthly manual testing, it still requires a visual inspection at least once a month. That inspection must check the display for a supervisory or trouble signal, or any other indication the equipment is not in good working order (2022 NYC Fire Code § 1027.9.1). The separate annual battery-power test of at least 90 minutes also remains required (FC § 1027.9.2).
